# Bayanihan project guidance

- Keep public browsing anonymous; never add public comments, likes, replies, or donor identities.
- Publish only source-attributed, verified hazards, stories, help requests, and donation channels.
- Treat payment, identity verification, public agency feeds, geolocation, and push delivery as server/provider integrations; never fake a live success in production.
- Keep any demo/sample request and payment clearly marked as demo data.
- Store identity evidence encrypted in private storage only; never expose private documents through public profile APIs.
- Preserve accessible keyboard behavior, responsive layouts, low-bandwidth fallbacks, and English/Filipino localization.
